Explicit authored analytic prerequisite restatement:
Finite real Hilbert/Borel E including0; V C2, NNReal alpha/beta with 0<alpha<=beta and actual all-point/all-vector alpha I<=HessV<=beta I. eta>0 and beta*eta<=1 are retained.
Actual Gaussian augmentation J=(x,x+sqrteta*xi)#(mu*standardGaussian) and common genuine Markov/disintegrating R/S with S_y=(2x-y)#R_y and S_y=volume.tilted(-W_y), W_y(z)=V((y+z)/2)+norm(z-y)^2/(8eta). Source C2 W_y, integrability/positive partition and original dense closable exact compact-smooth D_y with closed closure are produced. Only explicit W_y Hessian facts are extracted from the accepted curvature parent; its auxiliary R2/S2 are not equated with the resolvent kernels.
Construct genuine common R/S and for each y fix original D_y before epsilon/f. Produce ONE actual u in the SAME original D.closure.domain for every positive epsilon and forcing, all-domain variational identity, local-volume L1 of u/G, ALL C1 compact ordinary weak-gradient products/identity, local squared PDE residual and compact-volume L2, ALL C2 compact ordinary weak-Poisson products/identity, and ALL C2 compact chi actual v/Gchi/Fchi volumeL2/support/weak identities. Derive exact ((alpha+eta^-1)/4)*norm(D_y.closureu)^2<=norm(f-epsilon*u)^2<=normf^2 from true reflected lower/upper curvature. No joint measurable fiber choice or complete Poincare/BL/main result is inferred.
Same original compact-smooth gradient D precedes epsilon/f; derive ONE actual variational/localized resolvent u and actual weighted radial cutoff/commutator limits. Prove m*norm(D.closure u)^2<=norm(f-epsilon*u)^2<=normf^2 with source C2/two-sided0<m<=M Hessian bounds. E0 retained. No final limit/coercivity/core certificate, extra norm(x)*u moment, global ordinary Laplacian or drift-product L2, C-infinity potential, epsilon0/kernel/constant-domain/range/Poincare/BL/adjoint/core/jointselector/main/composition is inferred. Reflected quarter/fourfold constants exact; TV never transfers unbounded cost.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : NNReal} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α:ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E, (α:ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β:ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β:ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := Measure.map (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2)) (μ.prod (stdGaussian E))
    let W := fun y u : E => V ((1/2:ℝ) • (y+u)) + ‖u-y‖^2/(8*η)
    ∃ R S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel R ∧ IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (J.map Prod.swap).IsCondKernel R ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (R y).map (fun x => (2:ℝ) • x-y)) ∧
      ∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun u => -W y u) ∧
        ContDiff ℝ 2 (W y) ∧ Integrable (fun u => Real.exp (-W y u)) ∧
        0 < (∫ u, Real.exp (-W y u)) ∧
        ∃ D : Lp ℝ 2 (S y) →ₗ.[ℝ] Lp E 2 (S y),
          Dense (D.domain : Set (Lp ℝ 2 (S y))) ∧ D.IsClosable ∧ D.closure.IsClosed ∧
          (∀ (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) (v : Lp E 2 (S y)), (u,v) ∈ D.graph ↔
            ∃ f : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧ HasCompactSupport f ∧
              u =ᵐ[S y] f ∧ v =ᵐ[S y] gradient f) ∧
      ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∀ f : Lp ℝ 2 (S y),
      ∃ u : D.closure.domain,
        (∀ v : D.closure.domain,
          ε * ⟪(u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)), (v : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))⟫ +
            ⟪D.closure u, D.closure v⟫ = ⟪f, (v : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))⟫) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => D.closure u x) ∧
        (∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ v : E,
          Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
          (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) =
            - ∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => ‖ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
          inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x‖ ^ 2) ∧
        (∀ K : Set E, IsCompact K →
          MemLp (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x) 2 (volume.restrict K) ∧
          MemLp (fun x => D.closure u x) 2 (volume.restrict K) ∧
          MemLp (fun x => ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
            inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) 2 (volume.restrict K)) ∧
        (∀ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
          Integrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
            inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) * φ x) ∧
          (∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) =
            ∫ x, (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
              inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) * φ x) ∧
        (((α:ℝ)+1/η)/4)*‖D.closure u‖^2 ≤
          ‖f-ε • (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))‖^2 ∧
        ‖f-ε • (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))‖^2 ≤ ‖f‖^2 ∧
        ∀ χ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 χ → HasCompactSupport χ →
    let v := fun x => χ x * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x
    let Gχ := fun x => χ x • D.closure u x + (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x • gradient χ x
    let Fχ := fun x => χ x * (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x + inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) + 2 * inner ℝ (gradient χ x) (D.closure u x) +
      (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * Laplacian.laplacian χ x
    MemLp v 2 volume ∧ MemLp Gχ 2 volume ∧ MemLp Fχ 2 volume ∧
    tsupport v ⊆ tsupport χ ∧ tsupport Gχ ⊆ tsupport χ ∧ tsupport Fχ ⊆ tsupport χ ∧
    (∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ a : E,
      Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (Gχ x) a) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => v x * fderiv ℝ ψ x a) ∧
      (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (Gχ x) a) = -∫ x, v x * fderiv ℝ ψ x a) ∧
    ∀ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      Integrable (fun x => v x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => Fχ x * φ x) ∧
      (∫ x, v x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) = ∫ x, Fχ x * φ x

/-- The true reflected conditional kernels and original gradient graphs have an
actual positive-epsilon resolvent satisfying global quarter-scale coercivity.
All original variational/local/ordinary weak and cutoff data are retained. -/
theorem conditional_global_coercivity {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : NNReal} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α:ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E, (α:ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β:ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β:ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := Measure.map (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2)) (μ.prod (stdGaussian E))
    let W := fun y u : E => V ((1/2:ℝ) • (y+u)) + ‖u-y‖^2/(8*η)
    ∃ R S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel R ∧ IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (J.map Prod.swap).IsCondKernel R ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (R y).map (fun x => (2:ℝ) • x-y)) ∧
      ∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun u => -W y u) ∧
        ContDiff ℝ 2 (W y) ∧ Integrable (fun u => Real.exp (-W y u)) ∧
        0 < (∫ u, Real.exp (-W y u)) ∧
        ∃ D : Lp ℝ 2 (S y) →ₗ.[ℝ] Lp E 2 (S y),
          Dense (D.domain : Set (Lp ℝ 2 (S y))) ∧ D.IsClosable ∧ D.closure.IsClosed ∧
          (∀ (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) (v : Lp E 2 (S y)), (u,v) ∈ D.graph ↔
            ∃ f : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧ HasCompactSupport f ∧
              u =ᵐ[S y] f ∧ v =ᵐ[S y] gradient f) ∧
      ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∀ f : Lp ℝ 2 (S y),
      ∃ u : D.closure.domain,
        (∀ v : D.closure.domain,
          ε * ⟪(u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)), (v : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))⟫ +
            ⟪D.closure u, D.closure v⟫ = ⟪f, (v : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))⟫) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => D.closure u x) ∧
        (∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ v : E,
          Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
          (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) =
            - ∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => ‖ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
          inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x‖ ^ 2) ∧
        (∀ K : Set E, IsCompact K →
          MemLp (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x) 2 (volume.restrict K) ∧
          MemLp (fun x => D.closure u x) 2 (volume.restrict K) ∧
          MemLp (fun x => ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
            inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) 2 (volume.restrict K)) ∧
        (∀ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
          Integrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
            inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) * φ x) ∧
          (∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) =
            ∫ x, (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
              inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) * φ x) ∧
        (((α:ℝ)+1/η)/4)*‖D.closure u‖^2 ≤
          ‖f-ε • (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))‖^2 ∧
        ‖f-ε • (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))‖^2 ≤ ‖f‖^2 ∧
        ∀ χ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 χ → HasCompactSupport χ →
    let v := fun x => χ x * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x
    let Gχ := fun x => χ x • D.closure u x + (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x • gradient χ x
    let Fχ := fun x => χ x * (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x + inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) + 2 * inner ℝ (gradient χ x) (D.closure u x) +
      (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * Laplacian.laplacian χ x
    MemLp v 2 volume ∧ MemLp Gχ 2 volume ∧ MemLp Fχ 2 volume ∧
    tsupport v ⊆ tsupport χ ∧ tsupport Gχ ⊆ tsupport χ ∧ tsupport Fχ ⊆ tsupport χ ∧
    (∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ a : E,
      Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (Gχ x) a) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => v x * fderiv ℝ ψ x a) ∧
      (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (Gχ x) a) = -∫ x, v x * fderiv ℝ ψ x a) ∧
    ∀ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      Integrable (fun x => v x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => Fχ x * φ x) ∧
      (∫ x, v x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) = ∫ x, Fχ x * φ x := by
  obtain ⟨_R2,_S2,_hR2,_hS2,_hcond2,_hSR2,hcurv⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ConditionalScoreDomain.conditional_curvature_and_score_domain
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  obtain ⟨R,S,hR,hS,hcond,hSR,hfiber⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ConditionalLocalizedResolvent.conditional_localized_resolvent
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨R,S,hR,hS,hcond,hSR,?_⟩
  intro y
  obtain ⟨hSy,hW,hI,hZ,D,hDense,hClose,hClosed,hgraph,_⟩ := hfiber y
  obtain ⟨_,_,_,hderiv,hlower,_,_⟩ := hcurv y
  have hupper (x a : E) :
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun z => V ((1/2:ℝ) • (y+z))+‖z-y‖^2/(8*η))) x a) a
        ≤ (((β:ℝ)+1/η)/4)*‖a‖^2 := by
    rw [(hderiv x a a).1,real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    have hv := (hH ((1/2:ℝ) • (y+x)) a).2
    have hn : (((β:ℝ)+1/η)/4)*‖a‖^2 =
        (1/4:ℝ)*((β:ℝ)*‖a‖^2)+(1/(4*η))*‖a‖^2 := by ring
    rw [hn]
    nlinarith
  have hβ : (α:ℝ) ≤ (β:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hαβ
  have hm : 0 < ((α:ℝ)+1/η)/4 := by positivity
  have hmM : ((α:ℝ)+1/η)/4 ≤ ((β:ℝ)+1/η)/4 := by linarith
  refine ⟨hSy,hW,hI,hZ,D,hDense,hClose,hClosed,hgraph,?_⟩
  exact AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.GlobalWeightedResolventCoercivity.global_weak_resolvent_coercivity
    (fun z => V ((1/2:ℝ) • (y+z))+‖z-y‖^2/(8*η)) hW hI hZ
    (((α:ℝ)+1/η)/4) (((β:ℝ)+1/η)/4) hm hmM hlower hupper (S y) hSy D hClose hgraph

end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ConditionalGlobalCoercivity

reconstruction.text:
Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with NormedAddCommGroup, InnerProductSpace R, FiniteDimensional R, MeasurableSpace and BorelSpace instances and canonical ordinary Lebesgue volume; dimension zero is allowed. Let V:E->R, alpha,beta:NNReal and eta:R. Assume alpha cast to R is strictly positive, alpha<=beta, V is C2, and for all x,a:E BOTH diagonal actual Hessian bounds
  alpha*||a||^2 <= (fderiv R (fderiv R V) x a) a,
  (fderiv R (fderiv R V) x a) a <= beta*||a||^2.
Assume eta>0 and beta*eta<=1. Define actual measures and potential
  mu=volume.tilted(x->-V(x)),
  J=map((x,g)->(x,x+sqrt(eta)*g),mu.prod(stdGaussian E)),
  W_y(z)=V((y+z)/2)+||z-y||^2/(8*eta).
Tilted is the genuine normalized density against volume, and prod/map/stdGaussian are actual independent product, pushforward and standard real Hilbert Gaussian.
There exist kernels R,S:E->Measure E with all the following simultaneous properties: both are Markov kernels; R disintegrates the swapped actual joint J.map Prod.swap; and for every y, S(y)=(R(y)).map(x->2*x-y).
For every y in E, S(y)=volume.tilted(z->-W_y(z)), W_y is C2, exp(-W_y) is volume-integrable, and its volume integral strictly positive. For this y there exists a real-linear partial operator D:L2(S(y);R)->L2(S(y);E) whose domain is dense in scalar L2(S(y)), D closable and D.closure closed. Its exact graph condition is: for every scalar L2 a and vector L2 H, (a,H) belongs to D.graph iff there exists a smooth compactly supported real phi with a=phi S(y)-almost everywhere and H=gradient(phi) S(y)-almost everywhere.
For each y this same original D is fixed before epsilon/f.
For every real epsilon>0 and every f in L2(S(y);R), there exists ONE u in D.closure.domain satisfying all the following simultaneous conclusions. Write u_rep,f_rep for standard measurable representatives of the actual scalar L2 classes, and G_rep for the standard representative of the actual vector class G=D.closure(u). Abbreviate the exact displayed ordinary PDE expression by r(x)=epsilon*u_rep(x)+<gradient(W_y)(x),G_rep(x)>_E-f_rep(x).
(1) For every z in D.closure.domain,
  epsilon*<u,z>_{L2(S(y);R)}+<D.closure(u),D.closure(z)>_{L2(S(y);E)}=<f,z>_{L2(S(y);R)}.
(2) u_rep and G_rep are locally integrable with respect to ordinary Lebesgue volume.
(3) For every real C1 compactly supported psi and every direction a:E, both x->psi(x)*<G_rep(x),a>_E and x->u_rep(x)*(fderiv R psi x a) are volume-integrable and
  integral psi(x)*<G_rep(x),a>_E dx = - integral u_rep(x)*(fderiv R psi x a) dx.
(4) The real scalar function x->||r(x)||^2 is locally volume-integrable.
(5) For every compact K:Set E, u_rep,G_rep,r each satisfy actual MemLp at exponent 2 with respect to volume.restrict K.
(6) For every real C2 compactly supported q, both x->u_rep(x)*Delta(q)(x) and x->r(x)*q(x) are volume-integrable and
  integral u_rep(x)*Delta(q)(x) dx = integral r(x)*q(x) dx.
(7) The following TWO global scalar inequalities hold for the actual weighted quotient classes:
  ((alpha+1/eta)/4)*||D.closure(u)||_{L2(S(y);E)}^2 <= ||f-epsilon scalar-multiplied by u||_{L2(S(y);R)}^2,
  ||f-epsilon scalar-multiplied by u||_{L2(S(y);R)}^2 <= ||f||_{L2(S(y);R)}^2.
Here f-epsilon*u is subtraction in the actual scalar L2 quotient, not an independently selected pointwise residual witness. It is distinct from the ordinary PDE expression r.
(8) For every real C2 compactly supported chi, define the actual functions (v_chi denotes the statement's let-defined v)
  v_chi(x)=chi(x)*u_rep(x),
  G_chi(x)=chi(x) scalar-multiplied by G_rep(x)+u_rep(x) scalar-multiplied by gradient(chi)(x),
  F_chi(x)=chi(x)*r(x)+2*<gradient(chi)(x),G_rep(x)>_E+u_rep(x)*Delta(chi)(x).
Then v_chi,G_chi,F_chi each satisfy actual global MemLp 2 volume, and each topological support is contained in tsupport(chi): tsupport(v_chi) subset tsupport(chi), tsupport(G_chi) subset tsupport(chi), tsupport(F_chi) subset tsupport(chi).
For every real C1 compactly supported psi and direction a:E, both x->psi(x)*<G_chi(x),a>_E and x->v_chi(x)*(fderiv R psi x a) are volume-integrable and
  integral psi(x)*<G_chi(x),a>_E dx = - integral v_chi(x)*(fderiv R psi x a) dx.
For every real C2 compactly supported q, both x->v_chi(x)*Delta(q)(x) and x->F_chi(x)*q(x) are volume-integrable and
  integral v_chi(x)*Delta(q)(x) dx = integral F_chi(x)*q(x) dx.
All MemLp assertions mean actual a.e. strong measurability and finite L2 norm for their displayed measure. The ordinary local, compact-restricted and test assertions use canonical volume, whereas Hilbert inner products and both global inequalities use S(y). Derivatives/Laplacians of potentials/tests/cutoffs are actual operators; no pointwise classical derivative or total Laplacian of the rough representative u is asserted. The same u/G serves all tests, all compact restrictions, both inequalities and ALL cutoffs. chi only has C2 and compact support; no range, positivity or plateau condition is added.
The coefficient uses alpha cast to R and the exact real reciprocal 1/eta divided by 4. The global inequalities are ((alpha+1/eta)/4)*||D.closure(u)||^2 <= ||f-epsilon*u||^2 <= ||f||^2, with all norms under actual S(y). The approved reflected curvature constants are (alpha+1/eta)/4 and (beta+1/eta)/4; the output does not add a standalone Hessian inequality for W_y as another conjunct.
One common R,S pair works for every y, one D per y works for every positive epsilon/forcing, and one u per epsilon/f is chosen before ALL C2 cutoffs. All y have the stated density/operator facts, not merely almost every y; conditional disintegration retains its usual scope without claiming those identities for every possible version on exceptional y. No auxiliary curvature kernel is identified with an analytic resolvent kernel. No joint measurable y-dependent solution/cutoff selector is produced. The final cutoff block is ordinary volume-L2/support/weak-gradient/PDE data; no additional localized weighted-class graph membership, scalar cutoff estimate or approximation sequence is asserted in this statement.
The explicit endpoint is this global weighted scalar resolvent estimate at epsilon>0. Gradient-kernel/constant-domain characterization, epsilon=0/centered/range or further functional inequality, full generator-adjoint/core/global Bochner equality, main kernel-composition or actual-input expected-cost theorem are not conclusions. Ordinary unlocalized <gradient W_y,G_rep> and r have only the stated local/compact weak properties, without a separate globally weighted integrability assertion.
